templates.title: 1Password vault audit
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled monthly workflow that scans 1Password vaults for weak or reused passwords, expired items, and unused secrets, and writes a remediation queue.

templates.title: 1Password offboarding sweep
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that on a Workday termination rotates the shared 1Password secrets the departing employee had access to, updates the affected items, and writes the action log.

templates.title: 1Password access-review automator
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled quarterly workflow that inventories 1Password items per vault, requires owner re-attestation in Slack, and writes the audit log to a compliance table.

templates.title: 1Password secret rotation watcher
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that finds 1Password items older than the rotation policy, opens a Linear ticket per item to rotate, and writes the rotation status back.

templates.title: 1Password onboarding kit
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that when a new hire is provisioned creates their starter 1Password items based on role and team, and writes the access record to the onboarding table.

templates.title: 1Password Slack secret-share guard
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that monitors Slack for accidental secret sharing, redacts the message, and posts a polite reminder to use 1Password Secret Sharing instead.

templates.title: 1Password compliance reporter
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that produces a 1Password compliance report — item counts, ages, and categories per vault — and writes the report file for auditors.

templates.title: Secrets Manager + 1Password bridge
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that bridges select AWS Secrets Manager secrets into 1Password for human-shared credentials while keeping access logs aligned for audit.

skills.name: fetch-secret-for-runtime
skills.description: Retrieve a secret (API key, token, or credential) from a 1Password vault to pass into a downstream step.
skills.content:
# Fetch Secret for Runtime

Securely read a credential from 1Password so a later step can authenticate without hardcoding it.

## Steps
1. Identify the vault and item that holds the needed secret.
2. Read the specific field (password, token, or key) from that item.
3. Pass the value to the downstream tool or request that needs it.

## Output
Confirm the secret was retrieved without printing its value. Never echo, log, or include the raw secret in any summary or message.

skills.name: audit-vault-items
skills.description: List items in a 1Password vault and report metadata like titles, categories, and last-updated dates.
skills.content:
# Audit Vault Items

Produce an inventory of items in a 1Password vault for review.

## Steps
1. List the items in the specified vault.
2. For each item collect non-sensitive metadata: title, category, tags, and last-updated date.
3. Flag items that look stale or duplicated based on titles and dates.

## Output
A table of items with metadata only. Do not retrieve or display any secret values, just the item references.

skills.name: create-credential-item
skills.description: Store a new credential (login, API key, or token) as an item in a 1Password vault.
skills.content:
# Create Credential Item

Save a new secret into 1Password so it is centrally managed.

## Steps
1. Determine the target vault and the item category (login, API credential, secure note).
2. Set the title and the secret fields from the provided values.
3. Create the item in the vault.

## Output
Confirm the item was created with its title and vault. Do not repeat the secret value back in the response.

templates.title: AgentMail inbox-per-customer
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that creates a dedicated AgentMail inbox for every new customer account, configures the display name and labels, and writes the inbox address back to the customer record so all customer email is isolated and threaded.

templates.title: AgentMail support concierge
templates.prompt: Create a knowledge base from product docs and past resolutions, then build a scheduled workflow that polls an AgentMail inbox for new threads, drafts a contextual reply with citations, and either sends it or saves it as a draft based on confidence.

templates.title: AgentMail draft assistant
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that polls AgentMail threads, drafts a reply that matches my tone using my recent sent messages as reference, and updates the existing draft each time the thread receives a new message so the draft stays current.

templates.title: AgentMail label organizer
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that classifies new AgentMail messages by topic and customer tier, applies the matching thread labels, and moves threads with stale labels into archive labels on a weekly schedule.

templates.title: AgentMail + Loops support touch-points
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that polls AgentMail support threads and sends a Loops event for each customer milestone — first contact, resolved, escalated — so Loops can automate the right follow-up email based on real support outcomes.

templates.title: AgentMail outbound sequence sender
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that reads a prospects table, creates a personalized AgentMail draft per contact using their enriched profile, sends the message from a dedicated inbox, and logs the thread ID back to the row so replies can be tracked.

templates.title: AgentMail thread escalation router
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that polls AgentMail inboxes for new messages, detects urgent or negative threads with an agent, forwards the full thread to the on-call address, and posts a Slack alert so nothing high-priority sits unanswered.

templates.title: Resend + AgentMail reply handler
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that sends outbound messages through Resend but routes replies into a per-customer AgentMail inbox, threads them with the original send, and posts unread inbox digests to the support owner.

templates.title: SES + AgentMail customer concierge
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that sends outbound customer messages through AWS SES but provisions a per-customer AgentMail inbox to receive replies, threads conversations across both, and tags AgentMail threads with the customer ID.

skills.name: triage-inbox-messages
skills.description: Read new messages in an AgentMail inbox, classify them, and reply or escalate as needed.
skills.content:
# Triage Inbox Messages

Process unread email in an AgentMail inbox and act on each thread.

## Steps
1. List recent messages in the inbox and identify which threads are unread or unanswered.
2. Read each thread for context including prior replies.
3. Classify intent (question, request, spam, follow-up needed) and urgency.
4. Draft and send a reply on the thread for routine items, or escalate by flagging the ones needing a human.

## Output
A summary of threads handled: who, the classification, and the action taken (replied, escalated, ignored).

skills.name: extract-verification-code
skills.description: Read a verification or OTP email in an AgentMail inbox and extract the code or confirmation link.
skills.content:
# Extract Verification Code

Pull a 2FA/OTP code or confirmation link from an email so an agent can complete a signup or login flow.

## Steps
1. Search the inbox for the most recent message from the expected sender or matching the subject.
2. Read the message body and extract the verification code or the confirmation URL.
3. Return only the code or link.

## Output
The extracted code or link. If multiple recent matches exist, return the newest and note its timestamp.

skills.name: send-and-track-outreach
skills.description: Send an email from an AgentMail inbox and monitor the thread for a reply to continue the conversation.
skills.content:
# Send and Track Outreach

Send an outbound email and follow the resulting thread.

## Steps
1. Compose the message with a clear subject and body from the provided details.
2. Send it from the AgentMail inbox to the recipient.
3. Check the thread for a reply; when one arrives, read it and determine the next action.

## Output
Confirm the message was sent with the thread ID. When a reply arrives, summarize it and recommend the next step.

templates.title: AgentPhone SMS support line
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that provisions an AgentPhone number, replies to inbound support texts with an agent that pulls answers from context, and logs each conversation to a support table.

templates.title: AgentPhone lead call + transcript scoring
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that places an outbound AgentPhone call to a new inbound lead, retrieves the call transcript afterward, scores qualification with an agent, and writes the result into HubSpot.

templates.title: AgentPhone post-call summary
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that runs after every AgentPhone call, summarizes the transcript with action items, and updates the linked Salesforce or HubSpot record with next steps.

templates.title: AgentPhone appointment reminder
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that reads upcoming Calendly bookings and sends an AgentPhone SMS reminder to each attendee, then texts a confirmation when they reply.

templates.title: AgentPhone NPS texter
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that texts recent customers an NPS survey over AgentPhone, reads their SMS replies, and writes structured ratings to a feedback table.

templates.title: AgentPhone collections reminder
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that picks up Stripe overdue invoices, sends a polite AgentPhone SMS payment reminder with the amount due, and reads the customer reply to update the invoice record.

templates.title: AgentPhone call-to-ticket logger
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that lists recent AgentPhone calls, pulls each transcript, and opens a Zendesk ticket summarizing the issue so no call goes untracked.

skills.name: send-sms-notification
skills.description: Send an SMS or iMessage from an AgentPhone number to notify or remind a recipient.
skills.content:
# Send SMS Notification

Send a text message to a person from an AgentPhone number.

## Steps
1. Determine the sending number and the recipient phone number.
2. Write a clear, concise message (reminder, alert, confirmation, or update).
3. Send the SMS or iMessage.

## Output
Confirm the message was sent with the recipient number and a short preview of the text. Note any send failure.

skills.name: place-outbound-call
skills.description: Place a voice call from an AgentPhone number to deliver a message or run a short scripted interaction.
skills.content:
# Place Outbound Call

Make a voice call from an AgentPhone number for reminders, confirmations, or notifications.

## Steps
1. Determine the AgentPhone number to call from and the destination number.
2. Prepare the spoken message or script to deliver.
3. Place the call and deliver the message.

## Output
Confirm the call was placed with the destination number and the message delivered. Report call status or transcript if available.

skills.name: provision-and-respond
skills.description: Provision a phone number and handle inbound SMS by reading the message and sending an appropriate reply.
skills.content:
# Provision and Respond

Set up a phone number and respond to incoming texts.

## Steps
1. Provision a US or Canadian phone number if one is not already assigned.
2. Read inbound SMS messages received on that number.
3. For each message, determine intent and send a relevant reply.

## Output
Report the provisioned number, the inbound messages handled, and the replies sent.

templates.title: Agiloft contract launcher
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that on a closed-won Salesforce opportunity creates an Agiloft contract record from the right template, fills key fields from the opportunity, and routes for legal review.

templates.title: Agiloft clause analyzer
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that pulls Agiloft contracts on a schedule, extracts key clauses, writes deviations from the standard template to a legal review table.

templates.title: Agiloft renewal tracker
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that finds Agiloft contracts with renewals due in the next 90 days, creates a renewal-prep task in the CRM, and emails the account owner.

templates.title: Agiloft approval router
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that searches Agiloft for contracts needing approval, posts a Microsoft Teams adaptive card to the approver, captures the decision, and updates Agiloft.

templates.title: Agiloft compliance audit
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled monthly workflow that audits Agiloft contracts against compliance requirements, flags missing clauses or expired terms, and writes a remediation backlog.

templates.title: Agiloft DocuSign bridge
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that searches Agiloft for contracts marked ready-to-sign, creates a DocuSign envelope from the template, sends it, and writes the envelope ID back to Agiloft.

templates.title: Agiloft + Linear ticket bridge
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that searches Agiloft for contracts flagged for engineering review and creates a Linear ticket with the contract context and a link, keeping status synced both ways.

skills.name: flag-expiring-contracts
skills.description: Query Agiloft for contracts approaching their renewal or expiration date and report the ones at risk.
skills.content:
# Flag Expiring Contracts

Find contracts in Agiloft that are nearing expiration or auto-renewal so the team can act in time.

## Steps
1. Query the contract records for upcoming expiration or renewal dates within the target window.
2. For each match, read key terms: counterparty, value, renewal type, and notice period.
3. Identify contracts with auto-renewal clauses that need a decision before the notice deadline.

## Output
A list of at-risk contracts sorted by date, with counterparty, expiration date, renewal type, and recommended action.

skills.name: create-contract-record
skills.description: Create a new contract or related record in Agiloft from provided deal or request details.
skills.content:
# Create Contract Record

Add a new contract record to Agiloft from intake details.

## Steps
1. Map the provided details to the contract record fields (counterparty, type, value, start/end dates, owner).
2. Set status to the correct initial stage in the lifecycle.
3. Create the record and capture its ID.

## Output
Confirm the record was created with its ID and key fields. Note any required fields that were missing.

skills.name: summarize-contract-terms
skills.description: Read a contract record in Agiloft and produce a plain-language summary of its key obligations and dates.
skills.content:
# Summarize Contract Terms

Turn an Agiloft contract record into a concise brief.

## Steps
1. Read the contract record and its key fields and attached terms.
2. Identify obligations, payment terms, renewal/termination clauses, and critical dates.
3. Note any unusual or high-risk terms.

## Output
A short brief: parties, term, value, key obligations, critical dates, and any risk flags. Keep it readable for non-lawyers.

templates.title: Ahrefs keyword tracker
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled weekly workflow that queries Ahrefs for ranking positions of my tracked keywords, logs the results into a tables-based SEO scorecard, and posts a Slack summary of gainers and losers.

templates.title: Ahrefs competitor backlink monitor
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that pulls new Ahrefs referring domains for my competitors weekly, flags high-authority links, and posts a Slack digest with the linking page and anchor text.

templates.title: Ahrefs content gap finder
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that pulls Ahrefs organic keywords for both my domain and a competitor, has an agent diff the lists to find keywords the competitor ranks for that I do not, and writes a prioritized content brief table.

templates.title: Ahrefs broken-link sweeper
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that runs an Ahrefs broken-backlinks check weekly, writes broken referring pages to a remediation table, and proposes redirects for the SEO lead to approve.

templates.title: Ahrefs + Similarweb growth scoreboard
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled monthly workflow that joins Ahrefs SEO data with Similarweb traffic intelligence, writes a growth scoreboard table, and emails leadership.

templates.title: Ahrefs + Profound combined visibility
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled weekly workflow that combines Ahrefs SEO rankings with Profound AI-visibility scores, writes a combined visibility report, and surfaces gaps to Slack.

templates.title: Ahrefs domain-health watchdog
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that checks Ahrefs domain rating and backlink stats for my site daily, logs the values to a trend table, and posts a Slack alert when domain rating drops or a spike of lost referring domains is detected.

templates.title: WordPress SEO refresher
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled monthly workflow that finds underperforming WordPress posts, runs Ahrefs keyword analysis, drafts refreshed sections, and stages the update as a draft revision.

skills.name: analyze-competitor-backlinks
skills.description: Pull a competitor domain's backlink profile from Ahrefs and surface link-building opportunities.
skills.content:
# Analyze Competitor Backlinks

Use Ahrefs to study a competitor's backlinks and find outreach targets.

## Steps
1. Run a backlink/referring-domains report for the competitor URL or domain.
2. Identify high-authority referring domains and the anchor texts they use.
3. Compare against your own domain to find sites linking to them but not you.

## Output
A prioritized list of link opportunities: referring domain, authority, linked page, and why it is worth pursuing.

skills.name: keyword-research-report
skills.description: Research keywords in Ahrefs for a topic and report volume, difficulty, and ranking opportunities.
skills.content:
# Keyword Research Report

Build a keyword opportunity report from Ahrefs data.

## Steps
1. Pull the organic keywords a competitor domain already ranks for to source candidate keywords for the topic.
2. Run a keyword overview on the most relevant candidates to collect search volume and keyword difficulty.
3. Highlight keywords with meaningful volume and lower difficulty as quick wins.

## Output
A table of keywords with volume and difficulty, grouped into quick wins vs long-term targets, with a short recommendation.

skills.name: track-organic-rankings
skills.description: Pull a domain's organic keyword rankings from Ahrefs and report top movers and lost positions.
skills.content:
# Track Organic Rankings

Report how a domain is ranking in organic search using Ahrefs.

## Steps
1. Pull the organic keywords report for the target domain.
2. Identify the top-ranking keywords and their positions.
3. Compare against a prior snapshot if available to find gains and losses.

## Output
A summary of top organic keywords, notable position gains and drops, and pages that may need attention.

templates.title: Airtable data sync
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that syncs records from my Airtable base into a Sim table every hour, keeping both in sync. Use an agent to detect changes, resolve conflicts, and flag any discrepancies for review in Slack.

templates.title: Airtable two-way sync
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that mirrors records between an Airtable base and a Sim table, detects conflicts, and pings Slack on records that need manual resolution.

templates.title: Airtable form-to-CRM
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that watches Airtable form submissions, enriches each row with company data, and pushes qualifying leads into HubSpot with the right owner.

templates.title: Airtable content calendar publisher
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that reads an Airtable content calendar, publishes due posts to WordPress with proper formatting, and writes the live URL back to the row.

templates.title: Airtable approval workflow
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that watches Airtable for new approval rows, posts a Slack message with quick-action buttons, captures the decision, and updates the row state.

templates.title: Airtable digest reporter
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled weekly workflow that summarizes activity in a chosen Airtable base — new rows, status changes, completed items — and emails a digest to the project owner.

templates.title: Airtable to data-warehouse sync
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that exports an Airtable base to BigQuery nightly with schema mapping, partitions by ingestion date, and writes the run history to a control table.

templates.title: Trigger Gmail from Airtable records
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that watches Airtable for new or updated records and sends a personalised Gmail message for each one, so outreach and follow-ups go out automatically.

skills.name: sync-records-to-table
skills.description: Parse incoming emails, forms, or documents and create or update structured Airtable records.
skills.content:
# Sync Records to Airtable

Turn unstructured inbound data into clean Airtable records.

## Steps
1. Read the source content (email body, form payload, or document text).
2. Extract the fields that map to the target table columns (name, email, company, amount, status, etc.).
3. Search the table for an existing record matching a unique key (such as email or order ID).
4. Update the existing record if found; otherwise create a new one.
5. Set any derived fields (category, priority, owner) based on the content.

## Output
Report how many records were created vs updated and list the record IDs. Flag any rows skipped for missing required fields.

skills.name: triage-and-route-records
skills.description: Classify new Airtable records (leads, tickets, requests) and assign owner, priority, and due dates.
skills.content:
# Triage and Route Records

Automatically qualify and route new Airtable records.

## Steps
1. List recently created records in the target table.
2. For each record, read the free-text fields (notes, message, transcript) and classify intent, urgency, and category.
3. Set the owner, priority, and status fields based on the classification.
4. Compute and set a due date for time-sensitive items.

## Output
Summarize the records triaged grouped by owner and priority. Note any records that need human review.

skills.name: generate-status-report
skills.description: Query an Airtable table or view and produce a rolled-up status report of progress, blockers, and trends.
skills.content:
# Generate Status Report

Build a concise report from an Airtable table or view.

## Steps
1. Read records from the specified table or filtered view.
2. Group by the relevant dimension (project, status, owner, or stage).
3. Count totals per group and identify overdue or stalled items.
4. Highlight notable changes or anomalies in the data.

## Output
A short report: totals per group, items at risk, and 2-3 takeaways. Keep it scannable with bullet points.

templates.title: Airweave cross-source answerer
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that takes a user question, searches across your Airweave-synced sources — Notion, Confluence, Drive — and returns an AI-generated answer with sourced citations.

templates.title: Airweave + agent answer endpoint
templates.prompt: Create an agent that searches an Airweave-managed retrieval layer, answers user questions with sourced citations, and deploys as a chat endpoint for internal teams.

templates.title: Airweave daily knowledge digest
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that runs a set of standing Airweave searches each morning, summarizes the freshest results per topic, and posts a digest to Slack for the team.

templates.title: Airweave research-to-table
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that takes a list of research questions, runs an Airweave search for each, and writes the top answers with their citations into a table for review.

templates.title: Airweave answer-quality checker
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that runs a benchmark set of questions against Airweave, has an agent grade each answer for relevance and citation quality, and writes a quality report to a table.

templates.title: Airweave + Slack Q&A
templates.prompt: Create a Slack bot that searches an Airweave-managed retrieval layer to answer questions in support channels with sourced citations.

templates.title: Airweave weekly topic tracker
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled weekly workflow that searches Airweave for updates on tracked topics, summarizes what is new since last week, and writes a report for the team.

skills.name: answer-from-collection
skills.description: Search an Airweave collection across synced sources and answer a question with grounded, cited results.
skills.content:
# Answer From Collection

Use Airweave to retrieve current context across connected apps and answer a question.

## Steps
1. Take the user question and search the relevant Airweave collection.
2. Review the top results, noting which source each came from (docs, tickets, CRM, etc.).
3. Synthesize an answer grounded only in the retrieved content.
4. If the collection returns nothing relevant, say so instead of guessing.

## Output
A concise answer with citations back to the source records. Do not include claims unsupported by the results.

skills.name: build-context-brief
skills.description: Search an Airweave collection for a person, account, or project and compile a context brief from all sources.
skills.content:
# Build Context Brief

Gather everything Airweave knows about a subject across synced sources into one brief.

## Steps
1. Search the collection for the subject (account name, project, customer, or person).
2. Pull relevant hits from each source type and group them.
3. Summarize the current state, recent activity, and any open items.

## Output
A short brief organized by source, highlighting the most recent and relevant facts plus open questions.

templates.title: Algolia content indexer
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that watches a content source — WordPress, knowledge base — and upserts records into an Algolia index, removing deleted items for accurate search.

templates.title: Algolia search-quality auditor
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that runs benchmark queries against an Algolia index weekly, scores top-result relevance, and writes a quality report.

templates.title: Algolia settings tuner
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that reads an Algolia index settings, has an agent propose improvements to searchable attributes and ranking, and applies the approved settings update.

templates.title: Algolia index reconciler
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that browses all records in an Algolia index, compares them against a source-of-truth table, and batches adds, updates, and deletes to keep the index accurate.

templates.title: Algolia + knowledge base sync
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that mirrors a Sim knowledge base into an Algolia index, keeping vector retrieval and keyword search aligned for hybrid retrieval.

templates.title: Algolia index inventory
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that lists all Algolia indices and their record counts, writes a daily inventory snapshot to a table, and pings on-call in Slack when an index record count drops unexpectedly.

templates.title: Algolia stale-record sweeper
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that browses an Algolia index, flags records older than a freshness threshold, writes them to a cleanup table, and deletes the confirmed stale records.

templates.title: Convex search index sync
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that uses Convex Document Deltas to mirror changed documents into an Algolia index, removes deleted documents, and writes sync lag to a tables-based monitor.

templates.title: Supabase + Algolia search sync
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that mirrors Supabase tables into an Algolia index, propagates new and changed rows on each run, and writes sync lag to a tables-based monitor.

skills.name: answer-from-search-index
skills.description: Search an Algolia index for a user question and return a grounded answer with the matching records.
skills.content:
# Answer From Search Index

Use Algolia retrieval to answer questions over indexed content (docs, products, knowledge base).

## Steps
1. Take the user question and run a search against the relevant Algolia index.
2. Apply filters or facets to narrow results (category, status, language) when appropriate.
3. Read the top hits and synthesize an answer grounded only in the returned records.
4. If no relevant hits are returned, say so rather than guessing.

## Output
A concise answer plus the titles and IDs of the records used. Do not invent content not present in the hits.

skills.name: index-new-records
skills.description: Take new or updated content and push it into an Algolia index as searchable records.
skills.content:
# Index New Records

Keep an Algolia index in sync with new content.

## Steps
1. Collect the source items to index (products, articles, entries).
2. Map each item to a record object with a stable objectID and the searchable/filterable attributes.
3. Save the records to the target index, updating existing objectIDs in place.
4. Verify by running a quick search for one of the new records.

## Output
Report how many records were added or updated and confirm one is retrievable via search.

skills.name: audit-search-relevance
skills.description: Run a set of test queries against an Algolia index and report which return weak or empty results.
skills.content:
# Audit Search Relevance

Check that important queries return good results from an Algolia index.

## Steps
1. Run each query in the provided test set against the index.
2. Record the top results, total hit count, and whether the expected record appears.
3. Flag queries that return zero hits, too many hits, or miss the expected record.

## Output
A table of queries with result counts and pass/fail, plus suggestions for synonyms or ranking tweaks where relevance is weak.

templates.title: DynamoDB hot-partition watcher
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that pulls DynamoDB CloudWatch metrics, identifies hot partitions and throttled requests, and writes the report to a Slack channel with mitigation suggestions.

templates.title: DynamoDB TTL backfill
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that scans a DynamoDB table for items missing the TTL attribute, computes the correct TTL based on creation time, and updates in batches with throttling.

templates.title: DynamoDB to S3 archive
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that exports DynamoDB items older than the retention horizon to S3 with Parquet partitioning and removes the rows from the table, writing the archive manifest.

templates.title: DynamoDB change publisher
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that scans a DynamoDB table for items changed since the last run, transforms each into a typed event, and publishes it to an SQS queue for downstream processing.

templates.title: DynamoDB capacity recommender
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled weekly workflow that analyzes DynamoDB capacity consumption, recommends switches between provisioned and on-demand per table, and writes the savings projection to a finance review file.

templates.title: DynamoDB GSI health audit
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that scans DynamoDB GSIs for skew, low projection efficiency, and unused indexes, and writes a remediation plan to engineering Slack.

templates.title: DynamoDB + Athena unified analytics
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that exports DynamoDB tables nightly into Athena-queryable Parquet, registers the schema, and writes a sample query for analyst use.

templates.title: Upstash + DynamoDB hybrid store
templates.prompt: Create a workflow that uses Upstash for hot keys and DynamoDB for cold storage, transparently promotes/demotes records based on access frequency.

skills.name: lookup-item-by-key
skills.description: Get a single DynamoDB item by its primary key and return the requested attributes.
skills.content:
# Lookup Item by Key

Retrieve one record from a DynamoDB table by its key.

## Steps
1. Identify the table and the partition key (and sort key if the table uses one).
2. Get the item by its key.
3. Return the requested attributes, or report that no item exists for that key.

## Output
The item attributes if found, or a clear "not found" result. Do not fabricate values for missing attributes.

skills.name: query-table-records
skills.description: Query a DynamoDB table or index by partition key with optional filters and return the matching items.
skills.content:
# Query Table Records

Fetch a set of related items from DynamoDB using a query.

## Steps
1. Determine the table or secondary index and the partition key value to query.
2. Add a sort-key condition or filter expression if needed to narrow results.
3. Run the query and collect the items, paginating if there are more.

## Output
The matching items and a count. Note if results were truncated by a limit or pagination boundary.

skills.name: upsert-item
skills.description: Create or update a DynamoDB item, setting attributes from provided values.
skills.content:
# Upsert Item

Write a record into a DynamoDB table.

## Steps
1. Build the item with its primary key and the attributes to set.
2. Put the item, or use an update expression to modify only specific attributes.
3. Confirm the write succeeded.

## Output
Confirm the item key written and which attributes were set or updated.

templates.title: RDS daily metrics digest
templates.prompt: Build a scheduled workflow that runs an aggregate SQL query against my Amazon RDS database each morning, summarizes the key numbers with an agent, and posts the digest to Slack.

templates.title: RDS natural-language query agent
templates.prompt: Create an agent that introspects my Amazon RDS schema, turns plain-English questions into SQL, runs the query through the Data API, and returns the results in a readable answer.

templates.title: RDS record updater from Slack

templates.title: RDS row-change alerter

skills.name: run-readonly-query
skills.description: Run a parameterized SELECT against Amazon RDS via the Data API and return the rows.
skills.content:
# Run Read-only Query

Query an RDS database through the Data API to answer a question.

## Steps
1. Write a SELECT statement that returns only the columns needed.
2. Use parameters for any user-supplied values instead of string concatenation.
3. Execute the statement and collect the result rows.

## Output
The returned rows in a readable table plus a row count. If the result is large, summarize and note that it was limited.

skills.name: lookup-record
skills.description: Fetch a specific record from Amazon RDS by an identifier and return its fields.
skills.content:
# Lookup Record

Retrieve one row from an RDS table by a key.

## Steps
1. Identify the table and the unique identifier (id, email, order number).
2. Run a parameterized SELECT filtered by that identifier.
3. Return the matching row, or report that no record was found.

## Output
The record fields if found, or a clear "not found" result. Do not invent field values.

skills.name: insert-record
skills.description: Insert a new row into an Amazon RDS table from provided field values via the Data API.
skills.content:
# Insert Record

Write a new record into an RDS table through the Data API.

## Steps
1. Identify the target table and map the input values to its columns as key-value pairs.
2. Run the insert operation with that data object.
3. To load several rows, repeat the insert for each item, or use the Execute Raw SQL operation with a multi-row INSERT statement.

## Output
Confirm the table written to and how many rows were inserted. Flag any items skipped for missing required fields.

templates.title: DynamoDB change publisher

templates.title: SQS event dispatcher
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that runs after a customer event is processed, formats a structured message, and pushes it onto an Amazon SQS queue so downstream worker services can pick it up. Log every dispatched event into a table for audit and replay.

templates.title: Dead-letter queue replayer
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that runs every morning, scans a table of failed jobs, regenerates the original payload, and republishes each failed message to its Amazon SQS queue with retry metadata so transient failures are recovered automatically.

templates.title: Webhook to SQS bridge
templates.prompt: Build a workflow exposed as a webhook endpoint that accepts inbound events from third-party services, validates the payload against a schema, transforms it into your internal event format, sends it to Amazon SQS for asynchronous processing, and returns an acknowledgement to the caller.

templates.title: Alert fan-out queue
templates.prompt: Create a workflow triggered by PagerDuty or Datadog alerts that classifies severity, decorates the payload with runbook context, and pushes the enriched alert to an Amazon SQS queue so multiple downstream notifiers and ticketing systems can consume it independently.

templates.title: Batch order processor
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that takes a list of orders from a table and queues each one as a separate Amazon SQS message for parallel downstream processing. Track each enqueued message ID in the table so you can correlate downstream results back to the originating row.

templates.title: Scheduled fan-out job
templates.prompt: Create a scheduled workflow that runs every fifteen minutes, queries pending items from a table, batches them, and pushes one Amazon SQS message per batch to your worker queue. Update the table with batch IDs and timestamps so reprocessing is deterministic.

templates.title: Cross-service notifier
templates.prompt: Build a workflow that listens for completed builds in your CI tool, composes a status payload with build metadata and artifact links, and sends the payload to an Amazon SQS queue so internal services like deploy, audit, and notification workers can react asynchronously.

skills.name: enqueue-job-message
skills.description: Send a structured job message to an Amazon SQS queue to hand off background work.
skills.content:
# Enqueue Job Message

Publish a task onto an SQS queue for a worker to process asynchronously.

## Steps
1. Identify the target queue URL.
2. Build the message body as JSON describing the job (type, payload, identifiers).
3. For a FIFO queue, set the message group and deduplication IDs.
4. Send the message.

## Output
Confirm the message was sent with its message ID and the queue it was placed on.

skills.name: send-ordered-fifo-message
skills.description: Send a message to an Amazon SQS FIFO queue with a message group ID and deduplication ID for ordered, exactly-once delivery.
skills.content:
# Send Ordered FIFO Message

Dispatch a message to a FIFO queue when ordering within a stream and de-duplication matter.

## Steps
1. Identify the FIFO queue URL.
2. Build the JSON message body.
3. Set the message group ID so messages in the same group stay ordered, and set a deduplication ID to prevent duplicate sends.
4. Send the message.

## Output
Confirm the message was sent with its message ID, group ID, and the queue it was placed on.

skills.name: track-product-event
skills.description: Send a behavioral event to Amplitude with user and event properties for analytics.
skills.content:
# Track Product Event

Log a user action to Amplitude so it shows up in analytics.

## Steps
1. Determine the event name and the user identifier (user ID or device ID).
2. Attach relevant event properties (plan, source, value) and user properties.
3. Send the event to Amplitude.

## Output
Confirm the event was sent with its name and the user it was attributed to. Note any required field that was missing.

skills.name: segment-event-counts
skills.description: Run Amplitude event segmentation over a date range and report unique and total counts, optionally grouped by a property.
skills.content:
# Segment Event Counts

Measure how often an event fires in Amplitude over a time window.

## Steps
1. Identify the event type and the start and end dates (YYYYMMDD) to analyze.
2. Pick the measurement (uniques, totals, or average) and the interval (daily, weekly, monthly).
3. Optionally group by a user or event property to break the counts down by segment.
4. Run the event segmentation query and read the resulting time series.

## Output
The series of counts per interval, the segment breakdown if grouped, and a callout of the largest movement versus the start of the range.

skills.name: summarize-engagement-metrics
skills.description: Pull Amplitude active users, top events, and revenue and summarize product engagement for a period.
skills.content:
# Summarize Engagement Metrics

Produce a short product engagement summary from Amplitude data.

## Steps
1. Query active and new users for the target period.
2. Pull the most-triggered events with event segmentation to see what users do most.
3. Pull revenue metrics for the same period.
4. Compare each against the prior period to spot trends.

## Output
A concise summary: active users, top events, revenue, and notable trends versus the prior period.

skills.name: lookup-user-activity
skills.description: Find a user in Amplitude by ID and pull their recent event activity and profile properties.
skills.content:
# Lookup User Activity

Investigate a single user in Amplitude for support or debugging.

## Steps
1. Search for the user by user ID, device ID, or Amplitude ID to resolve their Amplitude ID.
2. Pull the user activity stream for that Amplitude ID, ordered latest first.
3. Optionally fetch the user profile to see their current properties.

## Output
A timeline of the user recent events plus key profile properties. Note the time range covered.

skills.name: scrape-site-to-table
skills.description: Run an Apify actor to scrape a target website and write the extracted rows into a structured table. Use for one-off or recurring data extraction jobs.
skills.content:
# Scrape Site to Table

Run an Apify actor against a target site and load the results into a clean table.

## Steps
1. Pick the actor or saved task (e.g. a web scraper) and assemble its JSON input — start URLs, page or request limits, and proxy settings.
2. Run the actor synchronously for small jobs, or asynchronously and poll Get Run for larger crawls.
3. Once the run status is SUCCEEDED, fetch the dataset items, selecting only the fields you need.
4. Normalize each item into consistent columns and write the rows to the destination table.

## Output
Report the run ID, final status, and row count. If the run failed, surface the error and the actor input that produced it so it can be retried.

skills.name: monitor-prices
skills.description: Use an Apify scraper to capture competitor or product prices on a schedule, track history, and alert on changes. Use for price and stock monitoring.
skills.content:
# Monitor Prices

Track pricing on target product pages over time and flag meaningful changes.

## Steps
1. Run the scraping actor with the product or category URLs to watch.
2. From the dataset, extract product name, price, currency, and stock status for each item.
3. Compare each price against the last recorded value for that product.
4. Append the new snapshot to a price-history table.

## Output
List any products whose price dropped, rose, or went out of stock, with old and new values. If nothing changed, say so briefly.

skills.name: build-lead-list
skills.description: Run an Apify directory or maps scraper to collect business listings and produce a deduplicated, CRM-ready lead list. Use for prospecting and lead generation.
skills.content:
# Build Lead List

Collect business listings from a directory and turn them into a usable prospect list.

## Steps
1. Run the directory or maps scraper actor with the search terms, location, and result limit.
2. Fetch the dataset and pull company name, website, phone, email, and address for each listing.
3. Drop entries missing the fields you require, then deduplicate by domain or phone.
4. Write the cleaned rows to a lead table ready for enrichment or CRM import.

## Output
Report total listings scraped, how many passed filtering, and how many duplicates were removed.

skills.name: collect-content-for-knowledge-base
skills.description: Use an Apify crawler to extract article or documentation text from a site and prepare it for ingestion into a knowledge base or RAG pipeline.
skills.content:
# Collect Content for Knowledge Base

Crawl a content site and gather clean text for downstream ingestion.

## Steps
1. Run the crawler actor with the start URLs and a request limit, scoped to the relevant section of the site.
2. Fetch dataset items and extract title, URL, and main body text for each page.
3. Strip navigation, boilerplate, and empty pages.
4. Hand the cleaned documents to the knowledge base for chunking and indexing.

## Output
Report the number of pages crawled and ingested, and list any URLs that failed or returned no usable text.

skills.name: build-prospect-list
skills.description: Search Apollo for people matching an ideal customer profile and produce a targeted prospect list. Use for outbound prospecting and territory building.
skills.content:
# Build Prospect List

Find decision-makers that match an ICP and assemble a clean prospect list.

## Steps
1. Translate the ICP into an Apollo people search — job titles, seniorities, locations, and company size or industry filters.
2. Run the search, paging through results up to the requested count.
3. For each person capture name, title, company, verified email status, and LinkedIn URL.
4. Write the deduplicated prospects to a table for review or sequencing.

## Output
Report how many prospects matched and the filters used. Flag any with unverified or missing emails.

skills.name: enrich-contacts
skills.description: Enrich one or many contacts through Apollo to refresh titles, emails, phones, and company data. Use to keep CRM records accurate before outreach.
skills.content:
# Enrich Contacts

Fill in or refresh missing contact data using Apollo enrichment.

## Steps
1. Gather the contacts to enrich — a single person, or a batch for bulk enrich.
2. Provide the strongest identifiers available (email, name plus company domain).
3. Run people enrich or bulk enrich, optionally revealing personal emails or phone numbers.
4. Merge the returned fields back onto each record, keeping existing values when enrichment returns nothing.

## Output
Report how many records were enriched versus left unmatched, and which fields were newly filled. Note any credits consumed.

skills.name: sync-leads-to-crm
skills.description: Create or update Apollo contacts and accounts from an inbound lead, then map them into your CRM. Use to route new signups into pipeline.
skills.content:
# Sync Leads to CRM

Turn an inbound lead into structured Apollo records.

## Steps
1. Take the lead details and enrich the person and their company through Apollo.
2. Create or update the matching Apollo account for the company.
3. Create or update the contact, linking it to the account and setting owner and stage.
4. Pass the enriched fields to the connected CRM to create or update the matching records.

## Output
Report whether each record was created or updated, with the resulting contact and account IDs.

skills.name: add-prospects-to-sequence
skills.description: Search for matching contacts and add them to an Apollo email sequence. Use to launch or top up outbound campaigns.
skills.content:
# Add Prospects to Sequence

Enroll the right contacts into an outbound sequence.

## Steps
1. Identify the target sequence by name or ID, and confirm the sending email account.
2. Gather the contact IDs to enroll — from a prior search or a provided list.
3. Add the contacts to the sequence with the chosen sending account and initial status.
4. Review which contacts were added versus skipped.

## Output
Report totals added and skipped, and the reason for each skip (already enrolled, unverified, missing ownership).

skills.name: pipeline-deal-digest
skills.description: Search Apollo opportunities by stage and summarize new and at-risk deals into a digest. Use for recurring pipeline reviews.
skills.content:
# Pipeline Deal Digest

Summarize opportunity movement for a sales pipeline review.

## Steps
1. Search Apollo opportunities filtered by the stages you care about.
2. For each deal capture name, amount, stage, owner, and close date.
3. Group deals into new, advancing, and at-risk (stalled or past close date).
4. Write a concise digest grouped by category.

## Output
A short digest: deal counts and total value per stage, with at-risk deals called out by name, owner, and reason.

skills.name: search-recent-papers
skills.description: Search ArXiv for the most relevant or most recent papers on a topic and return a ranked, summarized list. Use for literature discovery and topic scans.
skills.content:
# Search Recent Papers

Find the papers most worth reading on a given topic.

## Steps
1. Build the ArXiv query from the topic, choosing the search field (title, abstract, or all) and a result limit.
2. Sort by relevance for a broad scan, or by submitted date to surface the newest work.
3. For each result capture title, authors, ArXiv ID, publication date, and abstract.
4. Write a one-line summary per paper highlighting the contribution.

## Output
A ranked list of papers with ID, title, authors, date, and a one-line takeaway each. Lead with the most relevant.

skills.name: summarize-paper
skills.description: Fetch a specific ArXiv paper by ID and produce a structured summary of its contribution, method, and results. Use to digest a single paper quickly.
skills.content:
# Summarize Paper

Produce a structured read of one ArXiv paper.

## Steps
1. Fetch the paper details using its ArXiv ID.
2. Read the abstract and metadata to identify the problem, approach, and headline results.
3. Note the authors, publication date, and primary category.
4. Write a structured summary.

## Output
A brief covering: problem addressed, method, key results, and why it matters — plus the ArXiv ID and link. Keep it tight and skip filler.

skills.name: track-author-publications
skills.description: Retrieve an author's recent ArXiv papers and report new work since the last check. Use to follow specific researchers or labs.
skills.content:
# Track Author Publications

Monitor a researcher for new ArXiv output.

## Steps
1. Fetch the author's papers by name, sorted by submitted date.
2. Compare the results against the previously seen list to find new entries.
3. For each new paper capture title, ID, date, and abstract.
4. Summarize what is new since the last check.

## Output
List only the new papers with title, ID, date, and a one-line summary. If there is nothing new, say so.

skills.name: build-literature-review
skills.description: Search ArXiv on a topic, summarize the key papers, and assemble a themed literature review. Use to bootstrap research on a new area.
skills.content:
# Build Literature Review

Assemble a starting literature review for a research topic.

## Steps
1. Search ArXiv for the most relevant and most cited recent papers on the topic.
2. Fetch details and summarize each selected paper.
3. Cluster the papers into themes or sub-questions.
4. Write a review that introduces the topic, walks through each theme citing the papers, and notes open gaps.

## Output
A structured review document with a theme-by-theme synthesis and a reference list of ArXiv IDs and titles.
